verdict.rationale: The pack documents consent-based forwarding rules per destination (e.g. blocking forwarding when a CCPA opt-out is present). That is a consent-gating control, not per-destination hashing, masking or field-level filtering of sensitive attributes. The 'Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle' item is only a title and says nothing about PII hashing or masking, so the story's capability has no direct evidence.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes
